split.rule: t0 = timestamp(start_block), t1 = timestamp(end_block), T = t0 + floor(0.7 * (t1 - t0)) snapped down to the 30-second tick grid anchored at t0
split.learning_entry_rule: an entry is allowed only if cutoff + 902 <= T

learning.lesson_ceiling_rule: eligible candidate-ticks in LEARNING whose cutoff + 902 <= T, in cohorts of n >= 3, from the market-only tracker; no brain

primary.definition: FROZEN rows on tokens that were never eligible at a LEARNING tick inside the boundary — the tokens no lesson could ever have used

conditions: a primary grid under 100 labelled rows
